# Parameters
{: .no_toc }

Every parameter the pipeline accepts, grouped as in `--help`. They are checked against
[`nextflow_schema.json`](https://github.com/cellgeni/nf-reprocessing-public-10x/blob/main/nextflow_schema.json)
before anything is fetched: a wrong type (`--starsolo ture`), an unknown species or a missing
`--datasets` stops the run at once. `nextflow run main.nf --help` prints the same list.

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Input/output options

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--datasets` (required) | string (file) | – | Tab-separated table of dataset_id and sample_id, whatever its extension. Columns `dataset_id` and `sample_id`; `sample_id` holds comma-separated accessions. Leaving it empty processes the WHOLE series, which is intentional, but a series is often mixed: run with `--metaonly` first to see what it holds. |
| `--outdir` | string (directory) | `results` | Directory to save results. |
| `--publish_mode` | string | `link` | How published files are written into --outdir. Allowed: `symlink`, `rellink`, `link`, `copy`, `copyNoFollow`, `move`. |

## Run options

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--metaonly` | boolean | `false` | Only fetch metadata; skip downloading and alignment. |
| `--starsolo` | boolean | `false` | Align with STARsolo after downloading. |
| `--cellranger` | boolean | `false` | Align with Cell Ranger after downloading. |
| `--no_raw` | boolean | `false` | Publish nothing under raw/ (downloaded BAM/SRA/FASTQ, per-run and renamed FASTQs) nor their index CSVs. The files then exist only in the work directory. Pair it with `-profile lineage_keep` to have them deleted as each sample finishes, while a failed sample's stay for its -resume. |

## Species options

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--default_specie` | string | – | Species for samples whose metadata is missing or contradictory. Allowed: `human`, `mouse`. If unset, such samples are skipped with a warning and listed in skipped_samples.tsv. |
| `--no_infer_specie` | boolean | `false` | Ignore species in the metadata and assign --default_specie to every sample. Requires --default_specie. |

## Reference options

-profile sanger sets all five to the farm's copies; anywhere else pass the ones you need.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--wl_basedir` | string (directory) | – | Directory of 10x barcode whitelists, read by chemistry inference. Required unless --metaonly. Needs the 10x whitelists under their Cell Ranger names (737K-august-2016.txt, 3M-february-2018.txt, ...; see docs/10x_chemistry_reference.md). The STARsolo image ships them: `docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -v $PWD:/out quay.io/cellgeni/starsolo:v4.4 cp -r /opt/STARsolo/data/whitelists /out/`. |
| `--star_human_reference` | string (directory) | – | STAR index for human samples. --starsolo needs this or --star_mouse_reference. A genomeGenerate directory compatible with STAR 2.7.10a, the version in quay.io/cellgeni/starsolo:v4.4. The farm's is built from Cell Ranger's GRCh38 2020-A. |
| `--star_mouse_reference` | string (directory) | – | STAR index for mouse samples. --starsolo needs this or --star_human_reference. A genomeGenerate directory compatible with STAR 2.7.10a, the version in quay.io/cellgeni/starsolo:v4.4. The farm's is built from Cell Ranger's mm10 2020-A. |
| `--cr_human_reference` | string (directory) | – | Cell Ranger reference for human samples. --cellranger needs this or --cr_mouse_reference. |
| `--cr_mouse_reference` | string (directory) | – | Cell Ranger reference for mouse samples. --cellranger needs this or --cr_human_reference. |

## Rules across parameters

Combinations that stop the run at launch:

- `--no_infer_specie` needs `--default_specie`.
- A container engine is required: run with `-profile sanger`, `singularity` or `docker`.
- `--wl_basedir` is required unless `--metaonly` is set.
- `--starsolo` needs `--star_human_reference` or `--star_mouse_reference`, and `--cellranger` needs `--cr_human_reference` or `--cr_mouse_reference`. With only one of the two, the other species' samples are not aligned, and a warning says so.

## Hidden parameters

Not shown by `--help`; `--help --showHidden` lists them.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--help` | boolean | `false` | Show this help message and exit. |
| `--monochrome_logs` | boolean | `false` | Do not use coloured log output. |
| `--trace_report_suffix` | string | – | Suffix of the trace, report and DAG file names; defaults to the launch timestamp. |
